## About

RENOVATED ONE BEDROOM PARLOR APARTMENT WITH LAUNDRY IN PRIME BROOKLYN HEIGHTS!!  
Super bright one bedroom apartment in lovely Brooklyn Heights. The apartment features a large eat in kitchen with dishwasher and open concept living space.  
Super high 10ft ceilings, exposed bricks throughout. HUGE South facing windows. Bedroom fits a queen bed with furniture. Great closet space with additional storage.
